title: Origins: Midnight Alchemist
body:
# Midnight Alchemist 
Worshippers of the night, these insomniacs use their speed and heightened senses to track their prey.

### [+] Unbreaking Gaze
All nearby beings glitter with stardust while in your presence. 

### [+] Borealis Brew
You can bottle fragments of the night, which can be used as a blast or a heal.
[Badge: Info]:
Drinking this potion will heal you for 3 health and give a temporary speed boost.
[Badge: Star]:
[KEY: USE + SNEAK] while not in moonlight while holding a bottle in your offhand to fill it with the Borealis Brew, at the cost of hunger.

### [+] Art of Nyx
[KEY: PRIMARY] while holding the Borealis Brew to shoot a starlight beam. Missing or hitting a block will teleport you where the beam stops, but hitting an entity will teleport you to them and stun them, applying drowsiness. Teleporting in any way will create a cloud of moonlight around your feet, allowing 1 double jump in exchange for hunger. 
[Badge: Info]:
This blast will consume the Borealis Brew, leaving you with just a bottle.
[Badge: Arrow Up]:
Drowsy entities lose half of their armor and walk slower, but they will awake upon taking damage or after 5 seconds have passed. Hitting drowsy entities will feed you.

### [+] Bottle Fanatic
Entities slain by you have a 25% chance to drop a glass bottle.
You spawn with 4 glass bottles upon choosing this origin.

### [-] Inevitable Dawn
Your urge to see the stars makes you unable to rest. You may still set your spawn in beds

### [-] Exhausted Body
Your inability to rest causes you to lose hunger quicker, and heal slower. You are unable to heal from Regeneration or Instant Health effects.

If you have any problems feel free to reach out either on the origins discord or in dms!
